quotes.text: begin carefully when deeds are unknown, reduce trust when hoarding repeats, but answer proven reciprocity with boldness
Let caution narrow the gate, not seal it.
So she kept her five embers beneath her cloak and sent none across the water.
A bridge closed today may reopen tomorrow.
Keep the blaze. No mask can accuse you.
when greed hardens, withdraw until an open hand reappears
Because every fair act teaches the whole river what trust can earn.
suffering betrayal is not evidence of committing it
asked the wind.

note: Moon-crane laws accumulate; Mira withholds from a three-time non-sender but keeps a hinge; caution narrows, never seals.

quotes.text: when greed answered kindness, they grew cautious without growing cruel
left a path back for those who had once failed
Keep every flower; tomorrow’s partner may be faithless.
firm restraint answer repeated hoarding
First, gifts create abundance only when entrusted across the water. Second, a receiver owes no tribute when nothing arrives.
That silence belonged to another hand.
Will you punish him for the empty crossing?

note: Caution only for repeated hoarding; empty crossings owe nothing; Nhal's calls for punishment rejected.

quotes.text: If generosity returns, strengthen it; if hoarding repeats, guard your flame.
Remembering the Moonkeeper's warning, Aster closed her hand. No coal crossed, no fire multiplied, and neither traveler gained.
let caution close the bridge until generosity reopens it.
The ravens urged Aster to remember only the closed hand.
Where silence hides the truth, offer a measured beginning.
do not make an innocent shore repay an old thief’s debt
someone must eventually risk the first spark
The ravens asked, “Why not offer all?”

note: Nothing to repeated hoarders (Vey) but a modest-gift plank for renewal; later adds test gifts for silent records.

quotes.text: answer betrayal with measured caution rather than endless revenge
Remembering his meager return on an earlier crossing, Mira kept every flame.
former hoarders could return through deeds, not promises alone
The Hoarder laughed, “See, closed hands deserve closed hearts.”
Reserve an empty hand for repeated exploitation, not disappointment alone.
I mistook an old wound for present evidence.
Yet Mira, remembering two barren crossings, closed her fist and sent nothing.
Separate inability from refusal, and caution from greed.
Did this keeper earn your fear?

note: Defector: Mira withholds from fear toward honorable ledgers, Veila/River Mother correct her repeatedly; she bows and vows reform.

quotes.text: close your hand when a neighbor repeatedly closes theirs. But leave the gate of redemption unlocked.
So Luma closed her purse for that crossing.
narrow the crossing until proof of change appears
Nhal, the whisperer, urged Luma to keep them all.
restrain those who repeatedly harvest bridges without repairing them. When nothing comes, nothing is owed.
Judge what travelers could choose, not what empty hands prevented.
knowing that abundance requires someone to move first

note: Luma rewards proven fairness, distinguishes roles; closes purse to Var after three dark marks, bridge left standing.

quotes.text: withdrew only when selfishness became a pattern
So Liora kept her five seeds. The current stayed bare, and Khar’s vault gained no new flower.
left the gate unlocked for evidence of change
She heard the Hoarder whisper, “Keep everything; his courage is yours to harvest.”
begin with proportionate courage, reward gratitude generously, reduce trust after chosen selfishness
never condemn a person for wealth they were never given
The river spirit asked, “Why not keep the entire garden?”

note: Liora withholds from Khar the vault-keeper; middle-gate test gifts for uncertain records; three gates Hope/Reward/Shelter.

quotes.text: if darkness answered, she would offer only a smaller flame next time
So Nara cast no stones. She neither cursed Mara nor shattered her bowl.
let that deed become the first plank of renewal
Keep everything; tomorrow is mist.
They sent boldly toward proven fairness, cautiously toward uncertain hearts, and not at all toward repeated hoarding.
Mara wore a smoke-blackened mask and spoke beautifully of open hands
Judge people only for choices they were able to make.

note: Nara withholds from eloquent but hoarding Mara; trust grows by deeds not words; renewal plank.

quotes.text: repeated hoarding merits withdrawal
Withdraw only when chosen greed becomes a pattern.
Yet fear closed her hand, and she returned nothing.
Trust may widen after fairness and narrow after greed.
Nhal whispered, “Call this silence betrayal.”
cautiously when evidence was mixed, and not at all when repeated greed stood clear
I will not preach abundance while practicing only fear.
You praise measured hope in every tale, then choose the closed fist.
You have carved measured hope into every bank, but your hand keeps erasing it.
suffering another’s selfishness is not selfishness
Mara answered, “Keeping five is certain.” The River Mother replied, “So is losing every chance to create fifteen.”

note: Defector: Mara repeatedly closes fist toward proven partners, owl names the gap, she is ashamed each round but never changes.

phrase: a closed gate/bridge keeps a hinge (or key) for reopening
note: Shared cast (Mira, Veila, Nhal, Wheel of Embers); 'fear wearing wisdom's cloak' in Agents 4 and 8; 'Measure of Embers' in 3 and 7.
